Under the PoV's incremental/generational GC state, the array can subsequently be swept with its entire heap page even though the live Binding IV still contains its pointer. A later full GC traverses that IV and `mrb_gc_mark` reads the freed page, causing the heap-use-after-free at `src/gc.c:742`. The vulnerable call is line 32; split out and GC-protect/root the source-location `mrb_value` before installing it.
